spec.name: ingame-roots-and-amber
spec.prompt: Gently moving and hopeful, a colony at work: a calm harp and pizzicato string ostinato, a noble horn melody taken up by clarinet and flute, a warm wordless choir pad, light hand drums keeping a soft steady pulse. F major with modal colour, moderate slow tempo. A 30-second instrumental piece of background music for a fantasy real-time strategy game, played under the gameplay: a real composed piece with a clear melody and harmony, calmer and more spacious than a main theme, made to loop. Live orchestral and acoustic instruments only. No nature sounds, no birds or insects, no ambient soundscape, no drum kit, no synths, no electronic sound, no sung words.
